rationale: The stock gapped down ~5% on earnings and has been consolidating mid-range (55% of today's range) with very low 1-minute volume and tight, indecisive candles — no clear directional momentum. The wide bid-ask spread (40 bps) and lack of a defined catalyst or breakout structure make the risk/reward unfavorable relative to the daily loss budget.
